newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SCA to start incontinence j/v in Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: SCA to start incontinence j/v in Taiwan.

text.p: Swedish forestry company SCA said on Tuesday that its SCA Molnlycke unit would start a 50-50 joint venture for the manufacture of incontinence products in Taiwan and the Far East together with Advancetek Enterprise Company of Taiwan.
"The company is being founded on Advancetek's available production of incontinence products and will produce and market incontinence products in Taiwan and the Far East," SCA said in a statement.
The new company would be called Taiwan Sancella Enterprise Co, it said. It would set up a new productions plant and was due to be in operation at the end of 1998, SCA said.
